profile.summary: sebdeckers is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer specializing in Fastify, a high-performance Node.js web framework. Their contributions focus on robust backend development, particularly in async/await error handling, HTTP status codes, and middleware compatibility. They demonstrate strong attention to detail through documentation improvements, IPv6/IPv4 networking fixes, and semantic versioning adherence. While primarily a backend specialist, their work shows proficiency in modern JavaScript patterns and Node.js internals, making them a valuable asset for projects requiring reliable, production-grade Fastify implementations.
